Research on Building Massive Text Classification Models Based on Deep Learning
For large-scale text classification tasks, we propose a deep learning model based on a multi-layer Transformer. By integrating residual connections, dynamic context embedding, and multi-scale pooling mechanisms, the model enhances feature representation and classification performance on high-dimensional sparse corpora. Built upon static word vectors and traditional shallow networks, the model strengthens semantic modeling capabilities and end-to-end training efficiency. Experimental results demo
